datasets.title: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule throughout 2021, with geographic boundaries and food insecurity phase classifications recorded in GeoJSON and KML formats. The dataset represents spatial assessments of acute food insecurity conditions across administrative units in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys providing monthly assessments of acute food insecurity phases across geographic areas in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
